title: Chapter 3249 Romantically Apocalyptic
content:
After a while, Sable exhaled slowly.

"So, let me get this straight..."

She looked at Sunny with a mysterious expression and raised her hand, bending her fingers one by one.

"The two of you met at the gates of the Academy, just four weeks before the winter solstice. Then, you stumbled into each other in the Dream Realm... on the Forgotten Shore. She thought you were an assassin sent to kill her, while you were wary of her because of your Innate Ability. Nevertheless, you kept each other alive and became close companions — and maybe a little more, even if you kids did not understand it yet! But your friend, Cassie, saw a prophetic dream where one of you seemed to kill the other. And that tore you two apart."

Sunny nodded silently.

Sable bent the second finger.

"But! To escape the Dream Realm and Awaken, you still had to join forces. You fought side by side against the local tyrant and a horde of Nightmare Creatures, but in the end, only one of you could leave the Forgotten Shore. So you fought and nearly killed each other, and in the end, Nephis had to use your True Name to force you to leave her behind."

Sunny's expression darkened. He remained motionless for a few moments, then nodded again.

Sable bent the third figure.

“As a result, Nephis had to wander the Dream Realm alone for more than two years, eventually conquering the Second Nightmare — as a Sleeper, oh gods! And in the meantime, you conquered the Second Nightmare as well. She was the reason you kept pushing yourself to get stronger, while you were her only connection to the real world. Finally, you reunited, and even lived under the same roof for a while... tiptoeing around your feelings like shy little chicks... aww, how cute! But in the end, you got into another spat, and someone here ran all the way to another Quadrant and joined the military."

She bent the fourth finger. Now, only her thumb remained straight, and it looked as if she was giving Sunny a thumbs up.

With an unamused expression, Sable turned her wrist and pointed her thumb to the floor.

“Dastardly move, by the way!"

As Sunny coughed, she made a fist and shook it at him threateningly.

“Anyway, eventually, Nephis joined you in Antarctica, and after a disastrous battle, both of you ended up having to challenge the Third Nightmare. That part is still confusing to me. So, in the Nightmare... you got Corrupted and killed her? But then used some loophole in the time continuum to reset the whole thing and erase your own memories? So Nephis did not die, and you were even able to start flirting with each other — finally! — but then you ran away again and got your fate stolen by... a bird?... while she conquered the Nightmare. And as a result, everyone's memories of you were erased, instead."

Sunny hesitated for a moment, then nodded again.

"In my defense..."

But he did not finish speaking, noticing a friendly — and utterly chilling — smile on Sable's face.

"Defense? Oh, why would you need to defend yourself? Nobody is accusing you of anything, after all."

She let out a pleasant laugh.

Sunny shivered just as her laugh abruptly stopped.

Glaring at him, Sable said with the same chilling smile:

“After all, it's not like you killed my daughter or abandoned her on the eve of the decisive battle of the Third Nightmare... or had to die hundreds of times in some sort of weird time loop just to admit — not even to her, to yourself! — that you really, really loved her..."

Sunny let out a nervous chuckle.

"Ah... ha-ha. Well, it does sound bad when you put it like that..."

Sable waved a hand dismissively.

"But anyway! After going on a long journey across the Dream Realm, you decided to return and help Nephis from the shadows. And due to your Transcendent power, you split yourself into several incarnations. One was the Lord of Shadows, another was Master Sunless — the humble shopkeeper. And somehow, both ended up entangled with Nephis... one as her ally and hidden blade, the other as her secret spellsmith and fake boyfriend? Without her knowing that they were the same person!"

Sunny cleared his throat.

"I never intended for the shopkeeper to meet Nephis... she came to me on her own! In fact, it was all Cassie's fault. Blame her! But yes, that was basically it.”

Sable nodded.

"I see. So... you couldn't control yourself, could you? So, while shamelessly flirting with her as the Lord of Shadows, you also became her real boyfriend instead of a fake one as Master Sunless."

Sunny blinked.

"What? Shamelessly flirting? I did no such thing!"

Sable looked at him with a dubious expression.

"Oh, please. Didn't you mention that you princess-carried her out of danger? Went out of your way to display your immense power and unrivaled swordsmanship in front of her? Went on and on about how the Song clan daughters were all pretty and alluring, but held no candle to Nephis?"

He stared at her, stunned.

"Hey. I wouldn't say that I went on and on about it. I just... mentioned it in passing, once."

Sable gave him a long look.

"Uh-huh. No flirting involved, got it."

She sighed and shook her head.

“Well, at least you were honest with her from the start... about not being able to be honest, at least. So the two of you finally got together just before that Domain War, conquered the world, and have been in a loving relationship ever since. You even went to find that bird and took your fate back, knowing that it would give Nephis power over you. Because you trusted her and knew that she would never abuse that power."

Sunny smiled tentatively.

“Right. That's... that's a point in my favor, is it not?"

Sable looked at him in contemplation.

She remained silent for a long while, then nodded.

“Sure. In fact, am happy that you were by her side, Sunny. You... I don't think Nephis would have had anyone to share her burdens with, if it weren't for you. So, thank you for doing something that I should have done. Sincerely."

Calmed by her earnest tone, Sunny finally allowed himself to relax.

"But, Sunny..."

Suddenly, there was something ominous in the air.

Sable looked at him neutrally, and yet somehow, her eyes seemed like the eyes of an Unholy Titan.

“Why aren't you two married yet?"

He blinked.

"Huh?"

Sable smiled, sending chills running down his spine.

“I mean, you live together, fight together, sleep in one room. So why have you not proposed yet? Seems like a logical thing to do. Is my daughter not good enough... are you having doubts? Want to keep your options open? Well, of course, I understand... you have seven incarnations, after all, and they're all Supreme. There are many beautiful women in the world..."

Sunny stared at her with wide eyes.

“W—what?! No! That's not the reason! Absolutely not!"

Sable looked at him with a mischievous smile.

"Oh? What's the reason, then?"

Sunny stared at her in dumbfounded silence for a short while, then shook his head.

“Please don't misunderstand... it was an endless stream of disasters, calamities, and world-ending catastrophes ever since we admitted our feelings to each other. With the world falling apart as we desperately try to keep it from crumbling, have we really had time to think about such matters? It is not a very suitable time for a wedding, wouldn't you agree?"

Sable scrutinized him for a few excruciatingly long moments, then suddenly laughed.

“Gods! Relax, Sunny — I was just joking”

She paused for a moment.

"Although..."

She looked at him with a smile and said with a hint of warm nostalgia in her tone:

“Let me tell you, your father-in-law did not waste time. I barely had time to Awaken, and he was already lowering himself to one knee... he was grunting and groaning the whole way down, as well, since he had been beaten up by my dad just a day prior."

She looked into the distance, her smile turning soft.

Then, it slowly dimmed, and joy disappeared from her eyes.

With a sigh, Sable looked down.

“Don't think I didn't notice how carefully you avoided mentioning anything about who those Sovereigns you and Nephis defeated had been."

Her expression twisted for a moment, full of hurt and sorrow.

“But who else could have been the first to conquer the Fourth Nightmare? It must have been my cohort. Only there was no Broken Sword among the great and awesome Supremes... which means that he was dead by the time they established their kingdoms. And there is only one reason why Vale and Song would have sent assassins to kill my daughter."

She raised her head, an unfamiliar coldness settling on her exquisite features.

"It's the Legacy way... leave no living enemy behind you. If they were the ones who killed my husband and dismantled the Immortal Flame clan, they would have wanted to eliminate Nephis. Because they knew that if she was given a chance to grow up, she would come after them. Like she did."

For a moment, her eyes glistened with indescribable pain.

She remained silent for a long while, looking into the distance with a lost expression... she seemed to be confused, hurt, in denial, and accepting of the dark truth at the same time.

In the end, Sable asked quietly:

"What kind of world is this, Sunny?"

He studied her in silence, not knowing what to say.

He had lived countless lives... in those lives, he had been betrayed countless times and lost those he held dear on numerous occasions. That was why he could not find words to comfort her — he knew that there was nothing anyone could say that would soothe her pain.

In the end, Sunny simply said:

"It's the only world we have. And therefore, it is the kind of world that's worth protecting.”
